info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Rules-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Rules Retrieval API allows clients to access the current loyalty rules that govern customer rewards and benefits. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of rules, which can include eligibility criteria, points accumulation methods, and redemption options. Typical consumers of this API include mobile applications and web platforms that enhance customer engagement through loyalty programs. By integrating this endpoint, businesses can ensure their users are informed about how they can earn and redeem loyalty rewards effectively.

get.description: Fetches the current loyalty rules in place for the program. This endpoint provides necessary details regarding how customers earn and redeem rewards.
